column2: to in subsections (1), (2) and (3) are produced, the Commission
or  the  authorized  officer  shall  require  the  listed  public

(a)
to take copies of them or extracts from them; and

(b)
to require that person or any other person who is a
present or past officer of the listed public company
or was at any time employed by the listed public
company  to  provide  an  explanation  of  such
(c) where  the  records  and  documents  and  electronic
records  are  not  produced,  the  person  required  to
produce to give reasons for failure to produce such
(d) where the documents and electronic records are not
produced, the person required to produce them shall
disclose its location to the best of his knowledge
